purpose: Live-season diagnostic of the current T20 Challenger B on a franchise T20 competition. This is not a production validation or promotion test because the locked training corpus contains international T20s and no CPL matches.

model.selection_policy: K=80 was selected previously by validation log loss and is fixed for this prospective stream; no 2026 CPL result is used to select or refit the model coefficients.

live_state_policy.historical_state: The frozen Challenger B model is trained from the frozen international-T20 population. CPL franchise teams are not mapped to international teams or legacy franchise names.
live_state_policy.cpl_initial_state: All franchise-specific state starts cold at the canonical defaults and is updated sequentially using completed 2026 CPL results only.
live_state_policy.ball_strength_input: Scorecard-summary reconstruction for the live CPL matches; legal-ball counts from published overs are used because the locked corpus parser cannot ingest these web scorecards as canonical Cricsheet deliveries. This makes the snapshot a live diagnostic, not a strict canonical-run reproduction.
live_state_policy.prediction_freeze: Prediction is immutable once recorded; later CPL results may update the state only for subsequent fixtures.

match_16.fixture: Antigua and Barbuda Falcons vs Barbados Tridents
match_16.venue: Sir Vivian Richards Stadium, North Sound
match_16.feature_quality: CPL-specific live state reconstructed from published scorecard summaries; not a canonical Cricsheet delivery reconstruction.

provenance.training_contract: K=80; frozen male 2387/511/513 chronological split; 13-feature logistic model
provenance.prediction_note: The numerical Match 16 probability was reproduced locally from the current Challenger B contract using the locked corpus and a sequential CPL scorecard-summary state adapter. It must not be interpreted as a canonical Cricsheet reproduction until the 2026 CPL inputs are available in canonical delivery form.

promotion_policy: No promotion decision is permitted from this live-season stream. It is a prospective diagnostic only.
